Schedule Discord messages through a webhook

Limits and rules

Text2,000 characters

VideoNot supported yet

How to connect Discord

  1. You need the “Manage Webhooks” permission on the server. If you do not have it, ask a server admin.
  2. In Discord open Server settings → Integrations → Webhooks (on a phone: server name → Settings → Integrations → Webhooks) and press “New Webhook”.
  3. Choose the channel Vane should post to and press “Copy Webhook URL”. It starts with https://discord.com/api/webhooks/.
  4. In Vane Post choose Discord, paste the link and press Verify & connect. Vane checks it and saves it encrypted.

Tokens and keys are stored encrypted and you can disconnect at any time. How we protect them.

Questions about Discord

Why a webhook and not a login?

A webhook can only post to one channel. Vane gets no access to your account or the rest of the server.

Can a scheduled post ping everyone?

No. Mentions are disabled on posts sent through Vane.

How do I stop Vane posting?

Delete the webhook in Discord, or disconnect the channel in Vane.

Vane says it does not know the webhook.

The webhook was probably deleted, or only part of the link was copied. Create a new webhook in Discord, press “Copy Webhook URL” and paste the whole link.
